quest.title: A Trip Through Fog and Wind
quest.description: You discover a strange mural in the Golden Apple Archipelago...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This mural looks like it has some special meaning.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the marking is right on top of that mountain. Should we go have a look? Who knows, maybe we'll find something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the fog's finally behind us. But Paimon never thought that there'd be another island here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's keep on our guard as we have a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon never thought that there'd be a place like this here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? There's a journal here, too... Let's see what it says.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It says that there will be a gap in the fog around the northern island at noon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well then, why don't we do as the journal says and visit that northern island at noon?

talks.objective: According to the journal, you can pierce through the fog in the middle of the day (10:00 – 14:00)
According to the journal, you can pierce through the fog in the middle of the day (10:00 – 14:00)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Look, there's some sort of... drawing on this stone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like it shows people getting ready to board a ship.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't know what all this means, but let's record this mural down first.
